scientific_audit.topic: Scalar differentiation for a genuinely transverse complex Fourier direction
scientific_audit.argument: [INFERENCE: analytic source audit] With A(r)=epsilon*a*exp(i*q.r), differentiating exp[-i*integral_(rprime->r) A.dl] gives -i*((r-rprime).a)*integral_0^1 exp[i*q.(t*r+(1-t)*rprime)]dt. Fourier transformation therefore gives integral_0^1 a.(d_u+d_v)V(u,v)dt with u=pt-t*q and v=ps+(1-t)*q. This is complex-linear in a, not conjugate-linear. The oracle uses a=(0.23+0.11i,-0.17+0.19i,0) and a z-directed q; both real and imaginary directions are transverse. The material archive independently retains that same complex direction and a z-directed nonzero q.

[INFERENCE: analytic source audit] The derivative of (p+A)^2 is p.A+A.p. Its source-to-target Fourier element is (pt+ps).a when pt=ps+q. Since the checked edge convention is kt=ks+q+B*fold, the required integer join is mt=ms-fold, exactly the production join. The implementation uses a literal integer lookup rather than a cyclic FFT join and conjugates the kinetic coefficient while exchanging incoming/outgoing rows for the adjoint.

scientific_audit.topic: Straight-line NC phase and both projector legs
scientific_audit.argument: [INFERENCE: analytic source audit] For V(u,v)=B(u)D B(v)^dagger the two terms are B_a(u)D B(v)^dagger and B(u)D[B_conj(a)(v)]^dagger. The source bank must use conjugate(a) before its dagger; the implementation does. Placing both values and centered derivatives at u and v retains exp[-i*(pt-ps-q).tau]. The two differentiated atomic-placement contributions cancel as -i*(a.tau)+i*(a.tau), so omitting them from the centered derivative is correct, while discarding the remaining q-dependent placement phase would not be. Both terms are explicitly added for every original species/atom block.

[INFERENCE: analytic source audit] The nonlocal adjoint explicitly uses Bs*D^dagger*dt^dagger + ds*D^dagger*bt^dagger, with the original forward shifted banks, quadrature nodes and support. It does not reconstruct a reverse/refolded edge or replace a dagger with a transpose. FiniteQCurrentAction routes adjoint_apply to the adjoint branch, which selects adjoint_block; the scalar oracle compares against the literal dense matrix dagger on independent complex target vectors as well as a Hilbert-pair identity.

scientific_audit.topic: Electronic-current sign, Ry/Hartree units and uniform limit
scientific_audit.argument: [INFERENCE: analytic source audit] Under the declared positive-e shift a=e*A/(hbar*c), conversion of the Ry Hamiltonian derivative to Hartree and the electronic charge give J=-L_Ry/2. Both current methods and the persisted current overlap apply that factor exactly once. At q=0 with identical endpoint identity, the owner dispatches to the existing direct-physical PhysicalFieldVertices, extending real directions complex-linearly and conjugating the direction for the adjoint. Those real-direction vertices are Hermitian under the validated original Hermitian UPF D. The uniform check is not only a comparison with the reused production vertex: the oracle also compares it with the independently integrated scalar reference.

scientific_audit.topic: Literal scalar oracle changes the load-bearing representation
scientific_audit.assessment: independent at the new finite-q differentiation layer
scientific_audit.argument: The reference builds literal angular functions and the retained five-point radial Simpson measure, constructs the two-point real-space projector kernel, and multiplies it by the analytic straight-line factor ((r-rprime).a)*exp[i*q.(r+rprime)/2]*sinc[q.(r-rprime)/(2*pi)]. The reference therefore does not call the production finite-q projector helper, shifted-projector derivative banks or production line quadrature to construct its dense answer. Nonzero-epsilon evaluation uses the scalar exponential itself and central differences. Shared inputs are the synthetic UPF radial data, original D, endpoint geometry and Fourier convention; this is not an independent empirical/material model or a replacement radial proof.

[INFERENCE: analytic source audit] Along a=q, the t derivative of V(pt-tq,ps+(1-t)q) is minus q.(d_u+d_v)V, so the integrated nonlocal vertex is V(pt,ps+q)-V(pt-q,ps). The reference explicitly integrates those shifted kernels even outside retained endpoint support, rather than commuting two endpoint-truncated Hamiltonians. It supplies an additional gauge-identity check but is not used to infer the transverse answer.

scientific_audit.topic: Mutation sensitivity to plausible wrong physics
scientific_audit.assessment: exposing for the recorded synthetic case
scientific_audit.argument: The nine saved mutation defects expose omitted NC terms, the electronic-current sign, polarization conjugation, transpose versus dagger, the reciprocal fold, wrong complex phase information and a genuinely different transverse path. Each individual omitted-leg mutation subtracts a separately integrated real-space shifted-projector leg using adaptive integration, rather than a nominal fraction of the total vertex. The wrong_source_target_phase mutation conjugates the entire nonlocal matrix, so its sensitivity is not an isolated quantitative attribution to the atomic phase alone. The via-atom mutation is an explicitly different two-segment path, not evidence that the declared straight path is uniquely physically correct.
